title: Reasoning Reranking with Semantic IDs as the Sole Item Representation
abstract: arXiv:2610.22797v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Reasoning rerankers write a rationale before ranking a candidate slate, and existing systems read item metadata to do so, even though generative recommenders increasingly represent items as compact Semantic IDs (SIDs). Ranking from SIDs alone has two appeals: SID prompts are far shorter than the matched item text, and although item codes are fixed from content, the backbone learns their token embeddings in part from user-item interaction sequences, so the tokens can carry behavioral signal that item text lacks. That training targets next-item generation, and whether it supports ranking a supplied slate from SIDs alone is untested. We build ReRankID, a controlled testbed in which models reason and rank from a history and slate shown only as SIDs, varying item rendering, history length, and slate size one at a time. translated_title: 以语义ID作为唯一物品表示的推理重排序
translated_abstract: 推理重排序器在排定候选列表之前会先生成一段推理依据，而现有系统通过读取物品元数据来实现这一过程，尽管生成式推荐系统正日益采用紧凑的语义ID（SIDs）来表示物品。仅凭SID进行排序具有两点吸引力：其一，SID提示词远短于匹配的物品文本；其二，尽管物品编码由内容固定，但骨干模型会部分地从用户-物品交互序列中学习这些token的嵌入，因此这些token可以承载物品文本所缺乏的行为信号。然而，此类训练以“下一物品生成”为目标，其能否支持仅凭SID对给定的候选列表进行排序尚未得到验证。我们构建了ReRankID——一个受控测试平台，模型仅依据以SID形式呈现的历史与候选列表进行推理和排序，并每次仅改变一个变量：物品呈现方式、历史长度或候选列表大小。在该测试平台上，此类模型往往直接复制输入顺序而不进行重排序，且可读的元数据也无法修复这一失败。
tldr: 本文构建了ReRankID受控测试平台，首次系统评估仅以语义ID作为物品表示进行推理重排序的可行性，发现此类模型常常直接复制输入顺序而非真正重排序，且引入可读元数据也无法修复这一失败。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces ReRankID, a controlled testbed for reasoning reranking with Semantic IDs as the sole item representation, revealing that such models often copy the input order instead of reranking, and readable metadata does not repair this failure.
